Any generator with model-visible target leakage becomes BLOCKED even if class balance or marginal MI is good.
Any pre-universal-frame integrated cognitive row remains donor/retrofit material until model-visible H_before/H_after semantics pass the current gate.
Any evidence-bearing Hyperposition successor must preserve evidence identity, ancestry and independence group; duplicate packaging is not independent evidence.
For coupled alternatives, joint compatibility must be explicit; no implicit Cartesian completion.
Training execution, accepted dataset tokens and model credit remain separate from source/data-design status.
